label: H.R. 5764
title: AI for Main Street Act

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.

summary: AI for Main Street Act This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances.
summary_short: AI for Main Street Act This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances.
